messages:
support_jane: Customer reported SSO started failing right after their IdP rotated signing certs. They see a recipient/ACS mismatch and a signature validation error on our side.

devon_support: Can you paste the exact error and the metadata URL? Any repro steps from their side?

support_jane: Error from our logs: "SAMLResponse rejected: Recipient mismatch - AssertionRecipient 'https://app.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs/  ' not in SP ACS list".
They provided metadata: https://idp.customer.com/metadata (public). They said they uploaded it to our admin console and tested right after.

support_jane: Repro steps from customer: 1) IdP rotates cert, 2) new metadata auto-published by IdP, 3) they click our SSO link, 4) get 403 with above message + "Signature validation failed: X509Certificate parse error".

devon_support: Hmm two things: trailing spaces in ACS URL (note double space) and a cert parsing oddity. Can you fetch their metadata and paste the <AssertionConsumerService> entries and X509Certificate block?

support_jane: Pulled it and sanitized hostnames, but leaving exact whitespace: ```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.customer.com">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://app.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs/ " />
  </SPSSODescriptor>
  <KeyDescriptor use="signing">
    <KeyInfo>
      <X509Data>
        <X509Certificate>MIICazCCAdOgAwIBAgIJANb...
        MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEAp
        ...
      </X509Certificate>
    </X509Data>
  </KeyDescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Note the space after the ACS URL and the line-wrapped certificate with leading spaces on some lines.

tiffany_sre: That trailing space will make the parsed Location not match our stored ACS exactly (we store with no trailing space). Many SAML toolkits compare strings. Also some XML consumers include whitespace inside X509Certificate node; libs usually strip but if there are extra indentation spaces/newlines it can break naive base64 decoders.

devon_support: Quick checks: 1) curl -s https://idp.customer.com/metadata | xmllint --noblanks -  (see normalized) 2) echo "$(curl -s https://idp.customer.com/metadata | xmllint --xpath 'string(//AssertionConsumerService/@Location)' -)" | xxd -p -c 256  (confirm trailing space)

sam_product: If their IdP auto-published with that trailing space, they need to either update the IdP to send a clean Location or we accept an ACS alias on our side. We could add a normalization step to ignore trailing whitespace on ACS compare — but that's a behavioral change and could risk ambiguity.

devon_support: For immediate unblock, suggest: ask customer to re-upload metadata after running `xmllint --noblanks` or manually edit Location remove trailing space. Also ask them to provide the raw metadata file so we can run a local normalization and re-import.

infra-bot: ACTION CREATED: ticket #SUP-1089 assigned to devon_support. Priority: P2.

support_jane: Customer tried an upload with trimmed metadata and still saw "Signature validation failed". I inspected the X509Certificate block — they have line-leading spaces on some wrapped lines which some base64 parsers reject. Example snippet: ```
<X509Certificate>MIICaz...
        MIIBIjA...
</X509Certificate>
```
Those leading spaces inside the block cause base64 decode error in our parser (we log: "base64: invalid input").

tiffany_sre: That explains signature failure. Two remediation options: 1) Ask IdP to publish metadata with the cert block on a single line or with no leading spaces, 2) We add a tolerant pre-processor to strip whitespace/newlines in X509Certificate nodes before base64 decode.

devon_support: For now I validated by fetching their metadata and running: `xmllint --noblanks metadata.xml | sed -n 's/.*<X509Certificate>\(.*\)</X509Certificate>.*/\1/p' | tr -d '\n[:space:]' | base64 --decode >/dev/null` — it passes after trimming. I re-uploaded a cleaned copy to our test tenant and SSO succeeded.

support_jane: Customer accepted workaround and re-published cleaned metadata. They confirmed SSO works now. They asked if we can avoid this in future.

sam_product: Logged feature request: normalize/trim ACS Location and strip whitespace in X509Certificate before decode. We'll evaluate for a minor release; need security review.

devon_support: Closing interim troubleshooting steps in ticket SUP-1089. Recommend follow-up: engineering to discuss whether normalization is safe; ops to add a KB article describing how to sanitize metadata (xmllint + tr command examples).

support_jane: Marking thread resolved with customer ack :white_check_mark:.
